# Kiss Bands Tree

Read and follow [kissbandstree.md](../kissbandstree.md) before working on this
site. It defines the authoritative working directory, content formats, editorial
rules, photo requirements and verification checklist.

Inspect relevant existing entries and the PHP that reads them before editing.
Ask the user when identity, history or scope remains uncertain; never invent
missing data or silently treat an incomplete entry as complete.
